description: An image a reply or message embeds with ![alt](src) on its own line: a link line saying where it's from, with the picture under it. Local files and web images both work.

parts.name: source line
parts.shows: Above the picture, left-aligned: the path as the reply wrote it (or the web address), as a link, middle-ellipsized when long. Tooltip: "Open with default app" for a file, "Open in browser" for a web image.

actions.does: Opens the file in its default app, or the web image in the browser.

parts.name: picture
parts.shows: Under the line, 4px below, left-aligned, at most 480px on its longest side (smaller images at their own size), 6px rounded corners. Sized from its header at once, decoded as it comes near the view. Pointer: a magnifier. Tooltip: "<path or alt>\nClick to view · right-click for more".

actions.does: Opens the image viewer (ImageViewer) on it.
Menu: View, Open in browser (web images only), Copy image, Open with default app, Open in folder.

states.name: local file
states.shows: The src as a path (absolute, ~/, relative to the chat's folder, or file://): drawn at once.

states.name: web image loading
states.shows: Until it arrives, just a link "Image: <alt or URL>" (opens in the browser); then the source line and picture replace it.

states.name: can't be loaded / shown
states.shows: The "Image: …" link stays; its tooltip says "Couldn't load the image: <why>" or "Couldn't show the image: <why>".
